purpose: Challenge the sole Campaign067 candidate against the complete 98-definition historical library before any Campaign067 source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return is read.

candidate.name: quarterly_roe_profit_scale_efficiency_gap_2r
candidate.definition: Average-tie percentile rank of already-effective ROE minus average-tie percentile rank of already-effective net profit on the common finite two-field stock-day cross-section.

complete_library.numeric_order_rule: All 96 Campaign066 comparisons in frozen order, followed by quarterly_quality_rank_balance_3f/higher.

definition_level_challenges.reason: The candidate subtracts an independently ranked absolute earnings-scale state and therefore is not the ROE level itself.
quality_profit is profit-growth quality; the candidate uses the absolute point-in-time net-profit level only as a scale rank.
The candidate may still inherit a broad quality association and must pass the frozen correlation gate.
Absolute net-profit rank can proxy issuer scale, so the factor must be challenged against the frozen size proxy rather than assumed independent.
That factor compares two growth rates in percentage points; Campaign067 compares profitability efficiency rank with absolute earnings-scale rank.
Campaign066 measures three-component rank agreement and does not use net-profit scale; Campaign067 must nevertheless append and pass it as the final frozen comparison.
Its immutable snapshot has zero eligible rows, so it remains in the complete definition library but cannot supply a statistical comparison.
